title: Government announces appointments to four committees under Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board
content:
Government announces appointments to four committees under Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board30 June 2025
The Government today (June 30) announced the appointments to the four committees under the Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board (HKMPDB). The appointments will be effective from tomorrow (July 1), for a term of three years.
The HKMPDB will be established tomorrow as a high-level advisory body to assist the Government in formulating policies and long-term development strategies. In a press release issued on June 13, the Government announced the appointment and terms of reference of the HKMPDB, and the setting up of four committees under the HKMPDB to focus on specific areas of work, namely the Port Development Committee, the Maritime Services Development Committee, the Promotion and External Relations Committee and the Manpower Development Committee.
The Government appointed Dr Moses Cheng Mo-chi, Chairman of the HKMPDB, and three members, namely Ms Sabrina Chao Sih-ming, Mr Angad Banga and Mr Wellington Koo Tse-hau, as the Chairmen of the four committees to ensure effective linkage between the main Board and the committees. The membership of the committees features broad inclusion of industry stakeholders, including both ad personam and institutional members.
The terms of reference of the four committees are in the Annex. The membership of the committees is as follows and will be uploaded to the HKMPDB website.
